question: Leyline of Punishment says damage can't be prevented. If damage is dealt to Phyrexian Hydra, does the Hydra still put -1/-1 counters on itself?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the damage is dealt as normal and does not cause the Hydra to put -1/-1 counters on itself.
expected.answer: If damage dealt to Phyrexian Hydra can’t be prevented (due to Leyline of Punishment, for example), it will be dealt as normal and won’t cause Phyrexian Hydra to put -1/-1 counters on itself.

whyHard: The Hydra's counters come from its prevention effect, so when prevention is turned off its counters disappear with it.
